📦 **Sculpture `3c9c588`** — Complete Tidegrave dynamic audit and repair confirmed rig routes

Move six mizzen shrouds to real inboard deck ties, retain all 126 ratlines,
and remove four accidental yard bindings. Rejected aft feet hit gaff/boom;
rejected forward rail feet crossed the main shrouds. Route two aft backstays
to existing rooted crown horns and quantify their attachment contact.

Raise and shorten the jib to clear its original bowsprit/topsail crossings,
preserve the free clew and actual rope supports, and put the lateen sheet on
mirrored rooted brackets. Add exactly 56 voxels; preserve all previous
1,034,267 voxel colors, all 116 models/19 meshes and all 302 ropes.

Validation: complete continuous/asynchronous ten-yard sweeps and 48 mizzen
shroud/ratline plus two backstay capsule sweeps, zero unresolved intervals;
249 sampled all-rope poses; 23 actual physStep/fine-cloth cases; body/model,
rope/rope, cloth/cloth and rope/opaque-cloth evidence, true negative controls,
frozen sources, executable reruns and hashed compressed trajectories.
Final input f2561bfc294f91b849f59412d80294e9755e90a2ae1af8d81dea3ea7c2b06c9c:
1,034,323 voxels, checksum d931433f. CLI list comparison differs by zero
voxels/colors; one-color tamper changes checksum to be3b0c38.

Overall acceptance remains FAIL: intact opaque free cloth penetrates the
mast, crossjack and standing ropes. Keep TASK-0546 open, blocked by the
reproducible game-physics defect TASK-0603. Own gun/wheel hardware contacts
remain explicitly unclassified rather than hidden by an endpoint threshold.
No live Blockside change, formal import, push or parent pointer bump.

Refs TASK-0540
Refs TASK-0546
Refs TASK-0603

👥 參與者：@Sirius
